script: This is the SLEUTH API running on my laptop in fixture mode.
First I create a new project called Clip Five.
Next I save a short script with two lines.
Then I set a checklist with two items.
Now I ask for an upload link for the video.

Finally I start the analysis and check the job.
The job is queued, so the worker can pick it up.
